title: Heavenly Fate Converges as One
next_chapter_hook: Heavenly Fate Converges as One, and the legend of Chen Ji shall endure for eternity.

text.content:
When chaos first began, heaven and earth were undifferentiated.

The moment that seal completely shattered, Chen Ji felt himself falling into an endless void. No up or down, no left or right, no passage of time—only endless darkness, and a pair of eyes gazing intently at him.

Those were not the eyes of any living creature.

Those were — the Eyes of Heavenly Way.

dialogue.content: "At last we meet, the Seventh Prophet." That voice was like countless thunderclaps exploding simultaneously, yet also like a newborn's first cry, filled with the chaos of天地's beginning, "No, I should say — the Seventh Rebel."

text.content:
Chen Ji looked around and found himself standing in the void as a spiritual soul. The Tianji Record floated beside him, its torn pages flipping frantically as if in terror.

"Eyes of Heavenly Way..." he murmured, speaking that name, "So you truly exist."

"Exist?" That voice carried a hint of mockery, "I am older than this universe. Your life and death, glory and disgrace—all are beneath my gaze."

dialogue.content:
"The Tianji Record is merely a piece I placed in this world," that voice continued, "Generations of prophets thought they could glimpse Heavenly Secrets, yet they never knew that every 'foresight' of theirs was simply placing a piece on my chessboard."

"Did you think you were the chess player?" The Eyes of Heavenly Way seemed to laugh, "Pathetic. You are merely the seventh puppet selected by the Tianji Record."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then a faint smile curved his lips.

"Puppet?" he said slowly, his voice unusually calm, "If I were truly a puppet, how could I stand here questioning you?"

The void trembled slightly.

"Interesting," a note of amusement entered the Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice, "The first six all fell into despair and collapsed upon learning the truth. You are... quite unique."

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji!!"

A cold voice tore through the void. Chen Ji whirled around and saw Su Qingyao's figure struggling at the edge of the void, trying to break into this domain overshadowed by the Eyes of Heavenly Way.

"Don't come here!" Chen Ji shouted, but found himself unable to make a sound.

text.content:
"She is interesting," the Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice carried a trace of mockery, "A mere ant's body, yet daring to force her way in through the 'Shared Destiny' pact. What did you give her? Making her willing to die for you?"

Chen Ji clenched his fists.

"What you've always wanted isn't a prophet," he said heavily, "It's control. Isn't that right?"

dialogue.content:
"Control?" The Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice turned ice-cold instantly, "I am merely maintaining the order of this heaven and earth. Your life and death, reincarnation, rise and fall—all operate under my laws. If no one controlled it, this heaven and earth would have collapsed long ago!"

"So you want to make all living beings your marionettes?" Chen Ji冷笑, "Is that your so-called order?"

text.content:
Countless golden chains suddenly condensed in the void, each inscribed with ancient runes, bearing the pressure to suppress all things as they swept toward Chen Ji.

At the same time, a black figure swooped in from the other side — it was Ye Qing! Her demonic path mist tore a gap through the golden chains, forcefully breaking to Chen Ji's side.

"Idiot," blood trickled from the corner of her mouth, yet she smiled bewitchingly, "Coming to die alone won't do."

choice.prompt: Facing the oppression of the Eyes of Heavenly Way and the rushing support of his two beloved ones, Chen Ji must make his final choice — this concerns not only his own fate, but the future of the entire heaven and earth.

choices.description: Abandon the power of the Tianji Record, sever the connection with Heavenly Way. Walk the rest of life as a mortal, pursuing true freedom and liberation.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all cultivation and the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain true freedom, the soul no longer bound by anything
choices.risk_hint: Will lose all power, facing death with no protection

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, reached out, and gently pressed his hand on the cover of the Tianji Record.

"You're right," he murmured, "I was never any chess player. Since the fate of this world is controlled by you... then I don't want this fate."

The Tianji Record trembled violently, fragments of pages beginning to peel away one by one, dissolving into specks of light that scattered through the void.

choices.description: Accept the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, become the new master of Heavenly Way. At the cost of eternal solitude, guard the order of this heaven and earth.
choices.visible_reward: Become part of Heavenly Way, possessing the power to主宰万物生死
choices.risk_hint: Will die alone in loneliness, forever unable to experience mortal emotions again

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, a flash of determination appearing in his eyes.

"You say I'm a chess piece?" His voice suddenly turned ice-cold, "Then today I will overturn this chessboard!"

The torn pages of the Tianji Record slammed shut, and a brilliant light erupted from the book, wrapping Chen Ji's soul within it.

choices.description: Fuse with the Eyes of Heavenly Way, destroy the old order, establish a new world where all things are autonomous and Heavenly Way no longer enslaves living beings.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji's independent consciousness may dissipate
choices.visible_reward: Create a truly free new world, Chen Ji's will will integrate into all things
choices.risk_hint: May lose the self, forever disappearing between heaven and earth

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the void.

"You're wrong, Eyes of Heavenly Way," fire burned in his eyes like never before, "I didn't come to be a chess piece, nor to overturn the chessboard — I came to tell you that this chess game should never have existed from the start!"

He spread his arms wide, the Tianji Record thunderously unfurled, revealing the final page that no one had ever seen — blank.

【Path of Freedom】

The moment the Tianji Record dissolved into starry dust, Chen Ji felt the power that had supported him for countless years also draining away.

He felt no regret.

The Eyes of Heavenly Way let out a furious roar, countless golden chains rushing madly toward him — but to it, Chen Ji without the Tianji Record was merely an ordinary mortal. The power that could once easily crush stars could not harm him in the slightest.

"You... you actually gave it up!" The Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice was filled with disbelief, "That was your greatest power! You just said you didn't want it?!"

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao rushed forward, catching the staggering Chen Ji. Her eyes were red, yet her voice trembled with a smile: "Idiot... you truly are an idiot..."

Ye Qing also flew over, her demonic mist shrouding both of them: "Go! I'll send you out of this void!"

Chen Ji shook his head, gently grasping Su Qingyao's hand: "No need to flee. From now on... we are ordinary people. Living ordinarily, growing old ordinarily."

His gaze越过 the Eyes of Heavenly Way, toward the collapsing void — without the Tianji Record, without Heavenly Fate Values, the Eyes of Heavenly Way's control over this spacetime was rapidly瓦解ing.

"You... you think this will let you escape!" The Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice had grown weak, "Your karma remains! Your fate remains—"

"Karma? Fate?" Chen Ji smiled, that smile clean and pure, "Without the Tianji Record, what karma or fate do I have? I'm just an ordinary person who wants to live well."

In the void, the Eyes of Heavenly Way's roar grew fainter and fainter, until it completely disappeared from hearing.

text.content:
【Path of the Chess Player】

The moment the Tianji Record closed, surging power erupted from within, completely engulfing Chen Ji's soul.

He felt it — the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, the memories and power of countless prophets, pouring into his consciousness like rivers flowing into the sea.

"No!" The Eyes of Heavenly Way let out a terrified shriek, "You're mad! Bearing the full power of the Tianji Record, your soul won't withstand it—"

"Won't withstand it?" Chen Ji's voice echoed within the endless light, "Let me show you what it means to... rise from the ashes!"

Boom—!

The golden light of the Eyes of Heavenly Way and the white glow of the Tianji Record violently collided in the void. Two opposing forces tore at each other, devoured, merged.

"Impossible... impossible..." The Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice grew weaker, "I have existed for trillions of years... how could I be defeated by a mortal—"

"You weren't defeated by me," Chen Ji's voice resounded through the void like a heavenly declaration, "You were defeated by all who refuse to be chess pieces."

The final strand of golden light dissipated, and the Eyes of Heavenly Way completely perished.

And Chen Ji opened his eyes — within those eyes, the running tracks of the entire universe were now reflected.

dialogue.content:
The void stabilized once more.

Chen Ji stood alone in the new heaven and earth, everything around him within his perception — mountains and rivers, flowers and trees, the heartbeats and breaths of billions of living beings.

He had become the new Heavenly Way.

However, the price was — he could never leave this heaven and earth again.

Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's forms materialized in the void, but when they tried to approach Chen Ji, they were blocked by an invisible barrier.

"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao desperately beat against that barrier, "What do you mean by this!"

Chen Ji turned around, looking at those two faces full of tears. His lips moved, but found himself unable to utter any sound — because he was Heavenly Way, and Heavenly Way cannot have personal emotions.

"..."

He could only watch them, watch them grow old slowly through endless years, while he could only serve as a bystander, forever unable to reach them again.

Occasionally, in the long eternity, he would let a petal drift onto the path Su Qingyao once walked; occasionally, he would let a gentle breeze brush across Ye Qing's hair.

That was him saying—

"I remember you. I will always remember."

text.content:
【Path of Fusion】

The blank final page of the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with dazzling light — that was not text, but pure possibility.

"What are you doing!" The Eyes of Heavenly Way showed terror for the first time, "What is that—"

"This is something the Tianji Record has never recorded," Chen Ji's voice was calm as water, "It is called — Free Will."

Light swept out, merging with the golden light of the Eyes of Heavenly Way. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being torn apart, reorganized, torn apart again...

Pain.

Unbearable agony.

Yet within that agony, he saw countless scenes—

Chen Nian's tears when she was taken away; Han Lie's roar before his death in battle; Ling Yuan's despair as he fell into the abyss; the sigh from Mo Xiansheng before he dissipated...

Also Su Qingyao's solitary figure gazing at the starry sky countless nights; Ye Qing's resilience as she licked her wounds alone in darkness;

All beings toyed with by fate, all souls unwilling to yield to destiny — at this moment, all resonated with Chen Ji's will.

"No... impossible..." The Eyes of Heavenly Way's voice began to fragment, "A mere mortal... how could you bear so much will—"

dialogue.content:
"Because from the very beginning, there was no 'Heavenly Way'!"

Chen Ji's consciousness merged with the wills of countless living beings into a brilliant orb of light, violently striking the core of the Eyes of Heavenly Way — that thing called "Law of Fate."

BOOM!!!

The entire universe shook violently.

The Eyes of Heavenly Way let out a final wail, and then—

Collapsed.

When the light faded, Chen Ji found that he no longer existed. His consciousness, his memories, everything about him had integrated into every corner of this newborn universe.

But he still existed.

In the wind, in the water, in every beating heart, in every wisp of rising chimney smoke...

A new Heavenly Way was born — it was no longer some supreme consciousness, but the natural law of all things' operation. No ruler, no control, only eternal reincarnation and infinite possibility.

Chen Ji's name gradually faded from memory.

But occasionally, on a spring afternoon, a child playing by the stream would suddenly stop and stare into the distance, lost in thought.

"Big brother, what are you thinking about?"

"Nothing," the child smiled, "Just feeling... how comfortable this wind is."

text.content:
Epilogue · Legend

A thousand years later.

The Tianqing Sect no longer occupies its original mountain gate, but the name "Tianqing" has become one of the most revered titles in the cultivation world — because it was the place Chen Ji once protected.

Su Qingyao built a small wooden cottage on an unnamed mountain peak, practicing swordsmanship facing the sunset every day. Some said she was crazy, giving up a good position as Senior Fellow to seclude herself in the mountains.

But only she knew — she was waiting.

Waiting for the person who said, "When everything ends, we'll go live ordinary lives."

Ye Qing rebuilt the Holy Demon Sect, but this time, the sect's doctrine became the word "Freedom." She told every disciple: "We are not slaves to destiny, nor are we anyone's chess pieces."

One day, Chen Nian suddenly appeared before Su Qingyao's small wooden cottage. Her eyes held no more confusion, because she knew — her brother had completed his mission.

"Sister-in-law," she called Su Qingyao this, "Brother says he's very sorry. But he doesn't regret it."

Su Qingyao said nothing, only gazing at the magnificent evening glow, a faint smile on her lips.

"I know," she said, "I know everything."

The wind blew over the hills, over the fields, over thousands of miles of mountains and rivers.

That was Chen Ji's farewell, and also his eternal guardianship.

【The End of the Book】

Chen Ji's legend has been passed down through the river of time for millions of years.

Some say he was a model of trash-turned-genius, some say he was an infallible chess saint, some say he was a brave soul who broke fate, and others say — he was simply an ordinary person who wanted to protect those he loved.

The Tianji Record vanished.

But fate never disappeared.

At every crossroads of choice, at every abyss of despair, someone will always remember that name — Chen Ji.

Remember the torch he lit in the darkness; remember the courage he displayed in desperate situations; remember the words he said:

"I have calculated all under heaven, only to protect you."

Heaven's wheel turns, karma cycles.

But some stories never truly end.

——

The End of "Tianji Record."

Thank you for reading.

Chen Ji's chess game has concluded, but your life has just begun. May you, at the岔路口 of destiny, be like Chen Ji—

Infallible in strategy, yet never losing your original heart.

Playing the chess game of the world, yet unburdened by obsession.

This is the final lesson the Tianji Record wishes to impart to the world.
